purpose: Make every learner-facing resource reachable from the program, make the program reachable from every hosted reader, and preserve a prominent route to every authoritative original.

typed_relations.requirement: Each central course card exposes every admitted learner-facing hosted copy as a human-readable link.
Each central course card exposes authoritative originals separately from hosted copies, mirrors, repositories, and preservation records.
Every hosted HTML document links directly to the course anchor for every currently supported central interface language.
Every hosted HTML document links prominently to every authoritative-original URL bound to that course.

html_navigation.placement: one required landmark immediately after body start; a second bottom landmark is permitted and encouraged for long documents when its placement is declared and validated
html_navigation.absolute_https_links_required: central-language course anchors and authoritative-original targets must use absolute HTTPS; lineage-local contents or next/previous links may remain relative for portable closure
html_navigation.idempotence_marker: one stable lineage-owned marker per declared placement on each qualifying navigation landmark; the exact id, data attribute, class, and permitted placement set are bound by that lineage's deterministic tool and publication receipt rather than imposed retroactively on all readers

validation_gates.idempotence: a second transformation run must produce zero byte difference; public conformance is detected semantically as exactly one accessible nav landmark per declared placement containing every required central and authoritative-original target, while each lineage receipt binds its concrete marker and placement set
